summary: Iter74 — Tested 4 new ACL Admin CRUD endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE/toggle /api/acl/admins) and the two new admin pages (/admin/groups + /admin/admins). 16/16 new backend tests PASS. 33/33 regression tests (iter71+72+73) still PASS. Frontend renders 7 default groups with view-perms modal, filter+'Voir (N)' buttons, and the Administrator page supports full create → toggle → delete flow against the live backend. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/acl.py:282-310 — create_admin correctly bcrypt-hashes via core.deps.hash_password, lowercases email for dedup, returns user dict with password_hash stripped. role_name + role_ids[] both set so frontend list resolves the role badge.
/app/backend/routes/acl.py:313-342 — update_admin builds a partial $set payload; name auto-recomputed when first/last changes; email collision check uses {'id': {'$ne': user_id}}. Correct.
/app/backend/routes/acl.py:345-352 — delete_admin self-delete guard (400) is BEFORE the DB lookup, so users matching by id but not having role='admin' return 404 (correct).
/app/backend/routes/acl.py:355-362 — toggle_status defaults missing is_active to True (so a never-set user is flipped to False on first call). Behavior is consistent with frontend expectation.

/app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminManageAdmins.js — clean split of fields into first_name/last_name; password optional on edit. exportCsv uses simple BLOB download, no XSS risk since values are quote-escaped. Good data-testid coverage on every row and form field.

/app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminGroupsPage.js — system roles correctly disable edit/delete buttons (disabled={g.is_system}); view-permissions modal opens with green check chips per permission. 'Voir (N)' black button matches the V3Cube screenshot.

Minor (informational, not blocking): At /admin/admins first paint the row count is briefly 0 before /api/acl/users resolves — typical async load. Add a skeleton/loader if you want to hide this flash, but it is < 500 ms and resolves correctly.

Minor: pre-existing — backend/tests/test_iter71_p0_refactor.py and test_iter72_phase2_ui.py use 'from tests._creds import ...' which requires PYTHONPATH=/app/backend or running from /app/backend. test_iter73 + test_iter74 use 'from _creds import ...' (relative). For consistency, harmonize to one style. NOT caused by iter74.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (groups page renders 7 roles, view-perms modal works, filter works, admins page create+toggle+delete end-to-end OK)

test_credentials: admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! (super-admin) — works. test2@example.com / TestPass123! used to verify 403 on non-admin POST /api/acl/admins.
seed_data_creation: Tests create one admin per run with email TEST_iter74_<hex>@example.com and TEST_iter74_ui_<ts>@example.com; both are deleted in-test (no orphans).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_iter74_acl_admins.py -v (16 tests, no PYTHONPATH needed). For full backend regression: cd /app/backend && PYTHONPATH=/app/backend pytest tests/test_iter71_p0_refactor.py tests/test_iter72_phase2_ui.py tests/test_iter73_fixes.py tests/test_iter74_acl_admins.py -v (49 tests). Frontend: /admin/groups and /admin/admins are reachable from /admin sidebar after login at /login/email with admin@superapp.com. The new admin page uses [data-testid=admin-manage-admins] and [data-testid=admin-form-modal]; the groups page uses [data-testid=admin-groups-page] and [data-testid=view-permissions-modal].
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bug found. End-to-end POST /api/acl/admins followed by POST /api/auth/login with the same email/password returns 200 and user.role='admin', confirming bcrypt hashing path is correct.
